title: dynamic-qa Failure Evidence Bundle v1
description: The Failure Evidence Bundle DESIGN-dynamic-qa-spec.md §5.6 describes: 'immutable run/source/environment identities, original failed conclusion, Flow/step/outcome/Binding/provenance/profile mappings, normalized JUnit facts, safe expected-versus-observed facts, attempts, fixture and boundary enforcement, environment health, and digest-addressed approved diagnostics. It excludes secrets, production data, unrestricted bodies, whole workspaces, and unscrubbed evidence.' This is the ONLY artifact that may authorize `qa-generate repair --evidence <bundle>` (spec §7's Repair workflow step 1). This document is the human-readable contract only — no JSON Schema validator dependency is added, matching every other schema in this bundle. The actual hand-written, fail-closed validation — including the bundle-wide invariants this format alone cannot express, such as 'every free-text field is bounded and scrubbed', 'diagnosisRecord identity must agree with the bundle's own identity', and 'bundleDigest must match a recomputation or the bundle has been mutated' — lives in shared/scripts/failure-evidence.mjs.

schema.description: Immutable. Any other value is an unsupported-schema-version error, never a silent upgrade.

bundleId.description: Stable identifier for this bundle, distinct from any Diagnosis Record it carries.

sourceCommit.description: Full commit SHA of the run this evidence came from — never a branch name or short SHA. The bundle names a specific run tied to a source commit; this and workflow together are that identity.

workflow.description: Same identity shape as result-envelope.mjs's workflow field, produced by github-actions-adapter.mjs's resolveRunReference from a real run — never a free-text description of where the failure came from.

bindingId.description: Present when the failure is Binding-owned; required to agree with diagnosisRecord.bindingId when both are present.

profileId.description: The Execution Profile ID the run used.

provenanceDigest.description: Ties the bundle to a specific qa/provenance.json Binding entry.

originalConclusion.description: A Failure Evidence Bundle only ever documents a failed run. The historical failure remains failed regardless of any later repair (spec §7 step 7).

diagnosisRecord.description: Exactly one embedded Diagnosis Record (dynamic-qa-diagnosis-v1, #158) — never a list, never omitted. Its own causalChain is a single string, so a bundle structurally cannot carry more than one causal hypothesis. See shared/schemas/dynamic-qa-diagnosis-v1.schema.json for its full shape; validated here by diagnosis.mjs's own validateDiagnosisRecord, composed rather than re-implemented.

junitFacts.description: Normalized JUnit facts from the actual failing run — structured fields only, never a raw log excerpt.

message.description: Bounded and scrubbed (secret-detection.mjs) — never an unbounded log dump.

expectedVsObserved.description: The safe expected-versus-observed facts the design requires — bounded, scrubbed, tied to a stable Expected Outcome ID, never free prose.

approvedDiagnostics.description: Digest-addressed pointers to approved diagnostic artifacts — never inline raw content. Excludes secrets, production data, unrestricted bodies, and whole workspaces by construction: only a label and a sha256 digest are representable here.

bundleDigest.description: Canonical content digest (canonical-digest.mjs's contentDigest) over every OTHER field in this bundle. The immutability mechanism: any edit to the bundle after this digest was computed — including an edit meant to 'improve' evidence to justify a conclusion the original run never supported — is detected by recomputing and comparing. Evidence cannot be edited to justify a conclusion.
